input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, authentication domain. It serves Customer, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include cart, core, group. Core business data revolves around GroupVariant, Order, OrderItem, Product. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to add items to a shopping cart and check out, so that I can conveniently collect items before purchasing.
As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a Customer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a Customer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
